articles.title: Who is vfmaddrnd231pd??

Most x86 floating-point instructions use the global rounding mode, which can be slow, but vfmaddrnd231pd enables per-instruction control, allowing for faster algorithms. However, the Intel Software Development Manual documents it as VFMADDRND231PD, and the instruction is absent in the 2026 edition of the manual, despite being present in the 2024 edition. This raises questions about the origin and intended purpose of the instruction.

articles.title: Arena Allocators in C
articles.summary: Arena allocators in C allow you to manage memory by allocating small chunks of memory and freeing them when you're done, making it easier to avoid memory leaks and decrease the chance of them occurring. This paradigm is particularly useful in games and other applications where memory allocation is frequent. By grouping memory lifetimes into categories, arena allocators can help programmers keep track of when to free memory, reducing the risk of memory leaks.
